description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'CustomLocaleReceiver' that listens for specific intent actions to change the system's locale dynamically. It processes intents with the action 'com.android.intent.action.SET_LOCALE' and validates the locale string before applying it via the ChangeLocale utility.

classes.name: CustomLocaleReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for locale change intents and updates the system locale accordingly.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents, validates the locale string, and triggers the system locale change if valid.
